items.title: Vikram-1: India's First Private Orbital Rocket Mission
items.whyInNews: Vikram-1, India's first private orbital rocket mission, was successfully launched by Skyroot Aerospace, a Hyderabad-based start-up, on July 19, 2026.
items.summary: The Vikram-1 rocket was launched from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, and successfully placed its payload into orbit. This achievement marks a significant milestone in India's space programme, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulating the Skyroot Aerospace team on their success. The mission demonstrates India's growing capabilities in the space sector and highlights the potential for private players to contribute to the country's space programme.

items.title: Catch the Rain: National Appeal for Water Conservation
items.whyInNews: The government has launched a national appeal for water conservation, 'Catch the Rain', to promote rainwater harvesting and reduce water scarcity.
items.summary: The 'Catch the Rain' campaign, launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti, aims to promote rainwater harvesting and reduce water scarcity in India.
